# netgear_radio (Resource)

Manages the settings of one radio of the access point. Attributes that are not set keep the current value of the device. Destroying this resource leaves the device unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netgear_radio" "radio_2g" {
  band          = "2.4GHz"
  channel       = "6"
  channel_width = "HT20"
}

resource "netgear_radio" "radio_5g" {
  band          = "5GHz"
  channel       = "36"
  channel_width = "HT80"
  tx_power      = "half"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `band` (String) Radio band: `2.4GHz` or `5GHz`.

### Optional

- `aggregation_bytes` (Number) Maximum aggregation size in bytes (`2304`-`65535`). 2.4 GHz only.
- `aggregation_enabled` (Boolean) Enable frame aggregation. 2.4 GHz only.
- `aggregation_frames` (Number) Maximum number of aggregated frames (`1`-`255`). 2.4 GHz only.
- `channel` (String) Channel number or `auto`. The available channels depend on the country and the channel width.
- `channel_width` (String) Channel width: `HT20`, `HT40` or `HT20_40` for 2.4 GHz, `HT20`, `HT40`, `HT80` or `HT160` for 5 GHz.
- `client_limit` (Number) Maximum number of associated clients (`1`-`64`).
- `client_limit_enabled` (Boolean) Limit the number of associated clients.
- `green_mode` (Boolean) Green mode (obey the regulatory power limit).
- `rts_threshold` (Number) RTS threshold in bytes (`1`-`2346`).
- `tx_power` (String) Transmit power: `full`, `half` or `quarter`.
- `wireless_mode` (String) Wireless mode: `11axg` or `11ng` for 2.4 GHz, `11axa` or `11ac` for 5 GHz.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `band`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Radios are imported by their band: 2.4GHz or 5GHz.
terraform import netgear_radio.radio_5g 5GHz
```
